[SWS_DM_01046] Check supported DataIdentifier in active session
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04215, RS_Diag_04226
⌈
On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier (0x2A) with
transmission-Mode different than ’stopSending’, a requested Periodic DataIdentifier
shall be considered as supported if and only if the active session passes the exe-
cution permission check according to [SWS_DM_00413] else process next periodic
